<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2007|month=01|day=16|content=

* [[President of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz President]] [[Kurmanbek Bakiyev]] nominates [[Felix Kulov]] for [[Prime Minister of Kyrgyzstan|Prime Minister]]. If Kulov is confirmed by the [[Supreme Council (Kyrgyzstan)|Supreme Council]], this will be the third time Bakiyev has appointed Kulov Prime Minister. [http://www.rferl.org/featuresarticle/2007/1/37BD50F1-4AB1-46F8-A125-3A1D651A93B5.html (RadioFreeEurope/RadioLiberty)]
* [[Thailand]] summons the [[Singapore]]an ambassador to [[Bangkok]] to protest about a visit made by former [[Prime Minister of Thailand]] [[Thaksin Shinawatra]], deposed in the [[2006 Thai coup d'état]], to [[Singapore]]. Thaksin was able to meet the [[Deputy Prime Minister of Singapore|Singaporean Deputy Prime Minister]], [[S. Jayakumar (Singaporean politician)| S. Jayakumar]], but Singapore played down the meeting as "purely social and private". [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/6265857.stm (BBC)]
* The world's first [[genetically modified]] chickens have been bred by scientists in [[Edinburgh]]. The birds supposedly lay eggs that can help fight [[cancer]]. [http://www.timesonline.co.uk/article/0,,2087-2546462,00.html (The Times)]
* [[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa|2004-2006 Waziristan conflict]]:
** Pakistani cobra helicopter gunships destroy three suspected terrorist compounds in [[South Waziristan District|South Waziristan]] reportedly killing 8 people and wounding 10. [http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2007/01/16/ap/world/mainD8MMHGQ83.shtml (CBS News)] 
* [[Iraq War]]
** Two [[Mustansiriya University bombings|bombs]] at [[Al-Mustansiriya University|Mustansiriya University]] in [[Baghdad]] kill at least 70 people and wound 170 more. [http://edition.cnn.com/2007/WORLD/meast/01/16/iraq.main (CNN)]
